description: This file contains a PHP class implementing a PSR-7 HTTP response, specifically handling HTTP status codes, reason phrases, and response construction details.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Implementation of the PSR-7 ResponseInterface, managing HTTP response status, headers, and reason phrases.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Response object with status code, headers, body, version, and reason phrase.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response.

methods.name: getReasonPhrase
methods.description: Returns the reason phrase associated with the status code.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Returns a new Response object with specified status code and reason phrase.

methods.name: assertStatusCodeIsInteger
methods.description: Validates the status code is an integer.

methods.name: assertStatusCodeRange
methods.description: Ensures the status code is within the valid HTTP status code range (100-599).
